_comment: PFAS compound properties for photo-Fenton screening model.

PFOA.k_OH_source: Qian et al. 2016, Environ. Sci. Technol.
PFOA.gac_source: EPA PFAS Fact Sheet 2020; Long et al. 2023
PFOA.notes: Long-chain PFAS. NY MCL 10 ng/L effective 2023. EPA MCL 4 ng/L (2024).

PFOS.k_OH_source: Vecitis et al. 2008, J. Phys. Chem. A
PFOS.gac_source: EPA PFAS Fact Sheet 2020; Long et al. 2023
PFOS.notes: Long-chain PFAS. NY MCL 10 ng/L effective 2023. EPA MCL 4 ng/L (2024).

PFBA.k_OH_source: Qian et al. 2016, Environ. Sci. Technol. Higher k_OH than long-chain compounds due to differences in C-F bond environment and radical attack geometry for short-chain PFAS.
PFBA.gac_source: EPA PFAS Fact Sheet 2020; Long et al. 2023. Low value reflects weak van der Waals interactions for short-chain compounds.
PFBA.notes: Short-chain PFAS. No current NY or EPA MCL. Compared against 10 ng/L benchmark only.

PFNA.k_OH_source: Estimated from PFOA value (same order, similar chain length). Not experimentally confirmed.
PFNA.gac_source: Estimated. Long-chain PFAS adsorbs well to GAC.
PFNA.notes: Long-chain PFAS. k_OH is an estimate — treat results with extra caution.

PFHxS.k_OH_source: Estimated from PFOS value (same functional group, shorter chain).
PFHxS.gac_source: Estimated. Medium-chain PFAS, moderate GAC adsorption.
PFHxS.notes: Medium-chain PFAS. NY MCL 10 ng/L effective 2023. k_OH is an estimate.
